description: This file defines the UsersController class for the SuiteCRM application, handling user-related actions such as resetting preferences, deleting users, editing user details, and saving user and module preferences. It incorporates security checks, user data retrieval and updates, and page redirections, serving as a controller within the MVC architecture.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller class managing user-related actions in SuiteCRM, extending SugarController with methods for resetting preferences, deleting users, editing views, and saving user data.

methods.name: action_resetPreferences
methods.description: Resets preferences for a specified user if the current user has sufficient permissions.

methods.name: currentUserEqualsRecordUser
methods.description: Checks if the current user and the target user record are the same.

methods.name: action_delete
methods.description: Deletes (deactivates and marks as deleted) a user if the current user is an admin and not deleting their own account.

methods.name: action_wizard
methods.description: Sets the view to wizard for user setup.

methods.name: action_saveuserwizard
methods.description: Saves user details and preferences from the user wizard form.

methods.name: action_editview
methods.description: Prepares the edit view for user editing, with permission checks.

methods.name: action_detailview
methods.description: Prepares the detail view for user information, with permission checks.
